name: Twisted Love: Captive Souls
source:
You wake up to find yourself in a decrepit house with no one else but a girl who says she’s your girlfriend. But hold on… you can’t quite recall having one.

And you’re right. You soon discover that your so-called girlfriend is the one who confined you to her home out of sheer ‘love’ for you. Your only way out is with the help of her twin sister who, although sweet and shows genuine concern for you, has a few secrets of her own.

If you’re to learn anything from this, it’s that there’s a lot more to these sisters than meets the eye…
translation:
你醒来发现自己在一间破旧的房子里，除了一个自称是你女朋友的女孩之外没有其他人。但是等一下……你不太记得有过一个。

你是对的。你很快就会发现，你所谓的女朋友只是出于对你的“爱”而将你限制在她的家里。你唯一的出路是在她的双胞胎妹妹的帮助下，虽然她很可爱并且对你表现出真诚的关心，但她也有一些自己的秘密。

如果你想从中学到什么，那就是这些姐妹的内涵远比表面上看到的要多得多……
